rows.explainer: Lead accumulates in the body and causes damage to organs over time. Therefore, even when a source of exposure is removed, some of its health effects will persist (or be "locked in"). summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new charity advocating for regulation of used lead-acid battery recycling, modelled for Thailand, counting health and income gains from lower lead exposure. The idea LABRI (Lead-Acid Battery Recycling Initiative) was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet as it stands today, traced from its final cost per DALY equivalent; the published report gave about $42 per DALY ($17 per income doubling) from an earlier version.

theoretical.reason: Ambitious Impact's estimate of the idea, written before the charity existed; not based on the charity's own results.
theoretical.runs: LABRI advocates for regulating used lead-acid battery recycling, mainly in the Philippines (2026); AIM modelled Thailand.
